purpose: Reference values for the Kenward-Roger multi-df F scaling (pbkrtest KRmodcomp Ftest row: F = F.scaling * FtestU, ndf, ddf, p) plus the unscaled FtestU row.
regenerate: Rscript <script below> (run from the repository root; writes kr_scaled.json, copy it to this fixture path)
script:
suppressMessages({library(lme4); library(pbkrtest)})
ss <- read.csv("datasets/sleepstudy/data.csv")
ss$subj <- factor(ss$Subject)
ss$phase <- factor(ifelse(ss$Days <= 1, "a", ifelse(ss$Days <= 4, "b", ifelse(ss$Days <= 7, "c", "d"))))
ss$half <- factor(ifelse(ss$Days < 5, "early", "late"))
cases <- list(
 list(name="sleepstudy_phase_three_df", formula="Reaction ~ 1 + phase + (Days | subj)", L=rbind(c(0,1,0,0), c(0,0,1,0), c(0,0,0,1))),
 list(name="sleepstudy_days_half_two_df", formula="Reaction ~ 1 + Days + half + (Days | subj)", L=rbind(c(0,1,0), c(0,0,1))),
 list(name="sleepstudy_phase_contrast_two_df", formula="Reaction ~ 1 + phase + (Days | subj)", L=rbind(c(0,1,-1,0), c(0,0,1,-1)))
)
out <- list()
for (cs in cases) {
  fit <- lmer(as.formula(cs$formula), ss, REML = TRUE)
  t <- KRmodcomp(fit, cs$L)$test
  print(cs$name); print(fixef(fit)); print(t, digits=15)
  out[[length(out)+1]] <- list(name=cs$name, formula=cs$formula, label=paste0(cs$name, " = 0"),
     l=lapply(seq_len(nrow(cs$L)), function(i) cs$L[i,]), rhs=rep(0, nrow(cs$L)),
     numerator_df=t["Ftest","ndf"], denominator_df=t["Ftest","ddf"], statistic=t["Ftest","stat"], p_value=t["Ftest","p.value"],
     f_scaling=t["Ftest","F.scaling"], unscaled_statistic=t["FtestU","stat"], unscaled_p_value=t["FtestU","p.value"],
     coefficient_names=names(fixef(fit)))
}
res <- list(schema_version="1.0.0",
  generated_with=list(r_version=paste(R.version$major, R.version$minor, sep="."),
     r_packages=list(lme4=as.character(packageVersion("lme4")), pbkrtest=as.character(packageVersion("pbkrtest"))),
     method="pbkrtest::KRmodcomp(lmer(formula, data, REML = TRUE), L)$test -- statistic/p_value/denominator_df from the scaled Ftest row (F = F.scaling * FtestU), unscaled_* from the FtestU row",
     data="datasets/sleepstudy/data.csv; subj = factor(Subject); phase = a (Days 0-1), b (2-4), c (5-7), d (8-9); half = early (Days < 5), late; treatment contrasts"),
  cases=out)
writeLines(jsonlite::toJSON(res, auto_unbox=TRUE, digits=NA, pretty=TRUE), "kr_scaled.json")
